description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeSubordinateModel class within the OrangeHRM project. The class models an employee's subordinate with related reporting details, implementing serialization and normalization functionalities. It constructs mappings for subordinate attributes and reporting method details based on a ReportTo entity.

classes.name: EmployeeSubordinateModel
classes.description: A model class representing an employee's subordinate details, including their identifier, name, termination info, and reporting method, formatted for API serialization and normalization.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the EmployeeSubordinateModel with a ReportTo entity, setting up attribute mappings and filters.
